address.docs:
**int**: The I²C address of the device. Defaults to `0x4D`.

*See also: [PCM5122](https://next.esphome.io/components/audio_dac/pcm5122#configuration-variables)*

bits_per_sample.docs:
**enum**: The bit depth of the audio samples. One of `16bit`, `24bit`, or `32bit`. Defaults to `16bit`.

*See also: [PCM5122](https://next.esphome.io/components/audio_dac/pcm5122#configuration-variables)*

i2c_id.docs:
The ID of the [I²C bus](https://next.esphome.io/components/i2c) the PCM5122 is connected to.

*See also: [PCM5122](https://next.esphome.io/components/audio_dac/pcm5122#configuration-variables)*
